# Claude Code Skills & Plugins

**434 production-ready skills for Claude Code and 12 other coding agents, covering engineering, product, marketing, compliance, finance and the C-suite. We test whether each skill loads when you ask in plain words, and [publish the results](VERIFIED.md).**









**Works with:** Claude Code · OpenAI Codex · Gemini CLI · OpenClaw · Hermes Agent[^hermes] · Mistral Vibe[^vibe] · Cursor · Aider · Windsurf · Kilo Code · OpenCode · Augment · Antigravity

## Install in one minute

**Claude Code**

```bash
/plugin marketplace add alirezarezvani/claude-skills
/plugin install engineering-skills@claude-code-skills
```

**Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot and other agents** (the open-source [`skills`](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills) installer)

```bash
npx skills add alirezarezvani/claude-skills
```

More options for each tool are under [Quick Install](#quick-install).

## Pick your role

| You are | Install | You get |
|---|---|---|
| Software engineer | `engineering-skills` | Architecture, code review, TDD, frontend, backend, DevOps, security, QA |
| Platform or AI engineer | `engineering-advanced-skills` | Agent design, RAG, MCP servers, CI/CD, observability, SLOs, evals |
| Product manager | `product-skills` | Discovery, RICE, PRDs, user stories, roadmaps, UX research |
| Delivery lead or scrum master | `pm-skills` | Sprint health, Jira and Confluence, flow metrics, forecasts |
| Marketer | `marketing-skills` | SEO, answer-engine optimization, copywriting, CRO, email, paid ads |
| Founder or executive | `c-level-skills` | CEO, CTO, CFO, CMO, CRO and other advisors, board prep, hard calls |
| Regulated industry | `ra-qm-skills` | ISO 13485, EU MDR, FDA, ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, CAPA, risk files |
| Finance | `finance-skills` | DCF, budgets, SaaS metrics, month-end close |

Install with `/plugin install <name>@claude-code-skills`.

## Start with these

Each of these loaded on every plain-language test prompt. [See all verified skills](VERIFIED.md).

| Skill | What it does | Install |
|---|---|---|
| [agent-run-forensics](engineering/agent-run-forensics/) | Checks what your agent actually did against what it said it did, from the session transcript | `agent-run-forensics` |
| [human-gate](engineering/human-gate/) | Refuses to ship a plan, spec or migration until a named person has reviewed it and no blocker is open | `human-gate` |
| [skill-retro](engineering/skill-retro/) | Grades your skills from your own past sessions and proposes only the edits the evidence supports | `skill-retro` |
| [i18n-localization](engineering/i18n-localization/) | Finds missing keys, broken placeholders and wrong plural forms before a language ships | `i18n-localization` |
| [month-end-close](finance/month-end-close/) | Runs the close calendar, proves reconciliations and refuses boilerplate variance explanations | `month-end-close` |
| [cmmc-readiness](ra-qm-team/cmmc-readiness/) | Scores CMMC 2.0 Level 2 readiness, SPRS and POA&M close-out | `cmmc-readiness` |
| [cra-readiness](ra-qm-team/cra-readiness/) | EU Cyber Resilience Act: Article 14 reporting clock, product classes, Annex I and SBOM gates | `cra-readiness` |

[^hermes]: Hermes Agent is **BYO-sync tier**: the repo ships a pre-generated `.hermes/skills/claude-skills/` tree, but you run `python scripts/sync-hermes-skills.py` once locally to install into `~/.hermes/skills/`. Uses the same agentskills.io SKILL.md standard — no format conversion.
[^vibe]: Mistral Vibe is also **BYO-sync tier**: the repo ships a pre-generated `.vibe/skills/claude-skills/` tree, run `./scripts/vibe-install.sh` once locally to install into `~/.vibe/skills/`. Same agentskills.io SKILL.md standard — no format conversion. Docs: <https://docs.mistral.ai/mistral-vibe/agents-skills>.

## What Are Claude Code Skills & Agent Plugins?

Claude Code skills (also called agent skills or coding agent plugins) are modular instruction packages that give AI coding agents domain expertise they don't have out of the box. Each skill includes:

- **SKILL.md** — structured instructions, workflows, and decision frameworks
- **Python tools** — 824 CLI scripts (all stdlib-only, zero pip installs)
- **Reference docs** — 931 templates, checklists, and domain-specific knowledge files

**One repo, thirteen platforms.** Works natively as Claude Code plugins, Codex agent skills, Gemini CLI skills, Hermes Agent skills, Mistral Vibe skills, and converts to more tools via `scripts/convert.sh`. All 871 Python tools run anywhere Python runs.

### Skills vs Agents vs Personas

| | Skills | Agents | Personas |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Purpose** | How to execute a task | What task to do | Who is thinking |
| **Scope** | Single domain | Single domain | Cross-domain |
| **Voice** | Neutral | Professional | Personality-driven |
| **Example** | "Follow these steps for SEO" | "Run a security audit" | "Think like a startup CTO" |

All three work together. See [Orchestration](#orchestration) for how to combine them.

/plugin install ra-qm-skills@claude-code-skills                 # regulatory/quality
/plugin install pm-skills@claude-code-skills                    # project management
/plugin install c-level-skills@claude-code-skills               # C-level advisory (full C-suite)
/plugin install business-growth-skills@claude-code-skills       # business & growth
/plugin install finance-skills@claude-code-skills               # finance

# Or install a standalone plugin
/plugin install pw@claude-code-skills                           # Playwright testing toolkit
/plugin install self-improving-agent@claude-code-skills         # Auto-memory curation

## Multi-Tool Support (New)

**Convert the skills for 9 more AI coding tools** with a single script:

| Tool | Format | Install |
|------|--------|---------|
| **Cursor** | `.mdc` rules | `./scripts/install.sh --tool cursor --target .` |
| **Aider** | `CONVENTIONS.md` | `./scripts/install.sh --tool aider --target .` |
| **Kilo Code** | `.kilocode/rules/` | `./scripts/install.sh --tool kilocode --target .` |
| **Windsurf** | `.windsurf/skills/` | `./scripts/install.sh --tool windsurf --target .` |
| **OpenCode** | `.opencode/skills/` | `./scripts/install.sh --tool opencode --target .` |
| **Augment** | `.augment/rules/` | `./scripts/install.sh --tool augment --target .` |
| **Antigravity** | `~/.gemini/antigravity/skills/` | `./scripts/install.sh --tool antigravity` |
| **Hermes Agent** | `~/.hermes/skills/` | `python scripts/sync-hermes-skills.py --verbose` |
| **Mistral Vibe** | `~/.vibe/skills/` | `./scripts/vibe-install.sh` |

**How it works:**

```bash
# 1. Convert all skills to all tools (takes ~15 seconds)
./scripts/convert.sh --tool all

# 2. Install into your project (with confirmation)
./scripts/install.sh --tool cursor --target /path/to/project

# Or use --force to skip confirmation:
./scripts/install.sh --tool aider --target . --force

# 3. Verify
find .cursor/rules -name "*.mdc" | wc -l  # one file per skill
```

**Each tool gets:**
- ✅ All skills converted to native format
- ✅ Per-tool README with install/verify/update steps
- ✅ Support for scripts, references, templates where applicable
- ✅ Zero manual conversion work

Run `./scripts/convert.sh --tool all` to generate tool-specific outputs locally.

Personas

Pre-configured agent identities with curated skill loadouts, workflows, and distinct communication styles. Personas go beyond "use these skills" — they define how an agent thinks, prioritizes, and communicates.

Persona Domain Best For
Startup CTO Engineering + Strategy Architecture decisions, tech stack selection, team building, technical due diligence
Growth Marketer Marketing + Growth Content-led growth, launch strategy, channel optimization, bootstrapped marketing
Solo Founder Cross-domain One-person startups, side projects, MVP building, wearing all hats

Usage:

# Claude Code
cp agents/personas/startup-cto.md ~/.claude/agents/

# Any tool
./scripts/convert.sh --tool cursor  # Converts personas too

See agents/personas/ for details. Create your own with TEMPLATE.md.

Orchestration

A lightweight protocol for coordinating personas, skills, and agents on work that crosses domain boundaries. No framework required.

Four patterns:

Pattern What When
Solo Sprint Switch personas across project phases Side projects, MVPs, solo founders
Domain Deep-Dive One persona + multiple stacked skills Architecture reviews, compliance audits
Multi-Agent Handoff Personas review each other's output High-stakes decisions, launch readiness
Skill Chain Sequential skills, no persona needed Content pipelines, repeatable checklists

Example: 6-week product launch

Week 1-2: startup-cto + aws-solution-architect + senior-frontend → Build
Week 3-4: growth-marketer + launch-strategy + copywriting + seo-audit → Prepare
Week 5-6: solo-founder + email-sequence + analytics-tracking → Ship and iterate

See orchestration/ORCHESTRATION.md for the full protocol and examples.

FAQ

How do I install Claude Code plugins? Add the marketplace with /plugin marketplace add alirezarezvani/claude-skills, then install any skill bundle with /plugin install <name>@claude-code-skills.

Do these skills work with OpenAI Codex / Cursor / Windsurf / Aider / Mistral Vibe? Yes. Skills work natively with 13 tools: Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, Mistral Vibe, Cursor, Aider, Windsurf, Kilo Code, OpenCode, Augment, and Antigravity. Hermes Agent and Mistral Vibe both use the same agentskills.io SKILL.md standard — run python scripts/sync-hermes-skills.py or ./scripts/vibe-install.sh to install. For other tools run ./scripts/convert.sh --tool all then ./scripts/install.sh --tool <name>. See Multi-Tool Integrations for details.

Will updating break my installation? No. We follow semantic versioning and maintain backward compatibility within patch releases. Existing script arguments, plugin source paths, and SKILL.md structures are never changed in patch versions. See the CHANGELOG for details on each release.

Are the Python tools dependency-free? Yes. All 871 Python tools use the standard library only — zero pip installs required. Every skill's CLI entry point is verified to run with --help (most skills ship one script per tool; a few, like the vendored engineering/skillopt-sleep engine, ship a multi-module package behind a single python -m entry point). A few tools — engineering/book-to-skill's document extractors — can optionally use third-party parsers for higher-fidelity output, but every format falls back to a standard-library parser and nothing is installed implicitly.

How do I create my own Claude Code skill? Each skill is a folder with a SKILL.md (frontmatter + instructions), optional scripts/, references/, and assets/. See the Skills & Agents Factory for a step-by-step guide.

releases.body:
# 2.14.17 — app-store-optimization Google Play title limit fix
_Released 2026-11-26_

One community bug fix. The app-store-optimization tools validated Google Play titles against the old 50-character
limit; Google cut it to 30 in 2021, so a too-long title passed every check. No renames; `claude plugin update`
picks up marketing-skills.

### Fixed
- **app-store-optimization** (marketing-skills): `metadata_optimizer.py`, `localization_helper.py` and `launch_checklist.py` now enforce Google Play's 30-character app title limit instead of 50. SKILL.md, the README, the platform-requirements reference, the audit template and the example output are corrected to match; Apple limits are unchanged (#1172 via #1173, thanks @Walentalien).

## Thank you

This release includes work from @Walentalien
.

releases.body:
# 2.14.16 — scrum-master forecast and stock-analysis rate fixes
_Released 2026-11-23_

Two community bug fixes. scrum-master's Monte Carlo forecast now reports "X% confidence" as a total that X% of
simulated futures reach, so higher confidence means a smaller commitment; before, the 95% figure was one only 5%
of futures reached. stock-analysis reads `"1.5%"` as 1.5% instead of 150%, and warns on stage-1 growth above
100%/yr. No renames; `claude plugin update` picks up pm-skills and finance-skills.

### Fixed
- **scrum-master** (pm-skills): `velocity_analyzer.py`'s Monte Carlo forecast labelled the Xth percentile of simulated totals as "X% confidence", so the "95%" figure was a total only 5% of simulated futures reach. # 2.14.13 — NIS2, DORA and readme-polish
_Released 2026-11-17_

Two new EU cyber-compliance plugins for laws that already apply: nis2-readiness for NIS2 and the German
NIS2UmsuCG (in force since 6 December 2025), and dora-readiness for DORA (applies since 17 January 2025). Both

anything for you. Also new: readme-polish from the community. No renames, so nothing needs a reinstall;
`claude plugin update` picks up the new and changed plugins (ra-qm-skills, engineering-advanced-skills).

### Added
- **readme-polish** (new `engineering/readme-polish` plugin, also in the engineering-advanced-skills bundle): upgrades an existing README to the standard of the leading repos in its own category. It calibrates the presentation tier against 2-3 peer repos, runs a 15-second first-screen test, marks every claim true, stale or invented, rewrites the hero and hierarchy, and gates the result with `scripts/check_readme.py`, a stdlib-only lint for dead local links, placeholder badges, broken or non-ASCII anchors, oversized mermaid diagrams, wide tables and a missing first-screen install comma

aiSummary.oneLiner: A comprehensive open-source library of 360+ production-ready skills and plugins for 13 different AI coding agents.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: This repository offers a curated collection of specialized skills designed to extend the capabilities of AI models like Claude, Codex, and Gemini CLI. It provides modular, plug-and-play scripts covering engineering, DevOps, marketing, compliance, and enterprise research operations. The skills are structured as SKILL.md files to be easily integrated into existing agent orchestrators, providing standardized input and output formats. It includes complex capabilities like advanced web scraping, detailed code analysis, and PreToolUse hooks for security. By crowdsourcing these capabilities, the project aims to build a robust ecosystem of reusable tools for autonomous AI agents.
keyFeatures: Broad Agent Compatibility: Works out-of-the-box with Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Aider, and 8 other coding agents.
Extensive Skill Library: Contains over 360 production-ready skills ranging from DevOps workflows to C-level advisory personas.
Standardized Interfaces: Uses the agentskills.io SKILL.md format to ensure consistent execution across different agent platforms.
Research Operations Stack: Includes specialized tools for clinical research, market analysis, and deep academic literature reviews.
Customizable Slash Commands: Features over 70 custom commands like /cs:* for quick, specific autonomous actions.
